summary: Bitcoin remains stuck in a choppy range around $27,000 with failed breakouts on multiple timeframes causing frustration. While traditional risk markets like S&P 500 and NASDAQ show strength, crypto fails to participate. Litecoin and XRP are showing relative strength on BTC pairs with potential upside but Bitcoin's lack of direction makes trading alts risky. AI narrative is drawing speculative attention away from crypto, exchange volumes are at multi-year lows, and regulatory pressure on privacy coins adds uncertainty. Overall bearish sentiment with best approach being de-risking and waiting for clarity.
